summary: Frontend-only verification of CRM-only transformation and 'Connect Pro - Zelix' rebrand. All requested checks pass: admin login lands on CRM Overview (dashboard-page) with crm-kpis (kpi-total-leads, kpi-open-leads, kpi-converted, kpi-missed), lead-funnel, recent-leads-card, recent-contacts-card all rendered (not blank). Desktop sidebar exposes ONLY the 8 CRM nav items (nav-overview, nav-leads, nav-clients, nav-messages, nav-users, nav-branding, nav-activity, nav-settings) and none of the 14 removed education/finance nav items. All CRM routes (/leads, /clients, /messages, /users, /branding, /activity, /settings) load with non-blank content. Direct URL access to removed routes (/transactions, /invoices, /students, /colleges, /categories, /agents, /expense-requests) all redirect to / (Overview). Branding: browser title 'Connect Pro - Zelix', login hero shows 'Connect Pro - Zelix', 'Close More, Leads to Customers.', 'Sales · CRM Portal' badge, no 'Edu Connect'/'AdmissionOps' strings. Platform Owner login routes to /platform Console showing the single tenant 'Connect Pro - Zelix' with '7 modules'. The Edit-company modal's Enabled modules list contains ONLY the 7 CRM modules: Overview / Dashboard, Settings, Team & Permissions, CRM / Leads, Contacts, Messages, Activity Log — with zero references to Transactions/Accounts/Invoices/Students/Colleges/Categories/Admission/Ledger/Leave/Expense/Staff/Office/Quick Entry. No JS pageerror or runtime crashes on the authenticated UI; only benign 401s on /api/auth/me pre-login and 401s on unauth requests.
critical_code_review_comments: Rebrand + module trim looks complete end-to-end (sidebar, routes, platform module catalog, login hero, title). No stray education/finance surface detected on tenant or platform UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM-only transformation verified visually. Admin dashboard renders with correct testids (dashboard-page, crm-kpis, kpi-total-leads/open-leads/converted/missed, lead-funnel, recent-leads-card, recent-contacts-card). All 8 sidebar nav testids present; 14 legacy nav items absent. Removed routes redirect to /. Platform Edit-company modal 'Enabled modules' block lists exactly the 7 CRM modules with no legacy items. Main agent's concern about the screenshot tool returning blank frames after login is not reproducible here — the authenticated UI renders correctly.
